haikus.haiku:
soft peanut shells crack
warm butter melts over crunch
golden dust glows bright
Happy #NationalPeanutDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Dark cocoa melts warm
Scent of sugar rises near
Joyful bites unfold
Happy #InternationalChocolateDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Candle flames dance bright
Pages turn in night air, stars
Dreams bloom like firework
#HappyBirthdayRoaldDahl from @ClamBakeSanta

Morning light drifts slow
Cakes rise like sunrise gold bright
Joy sings in each bite
#HappyBirthdaySherwoodAnderson from @ClamBakeSanta
